SELECT 
    patient_avgs.SEX,
    AVG(patient_avgs.patient_avg_pt) as avg_pt,
    AVG(patient_avgs.patient_avg_ratio) as avg_ratio
FROM (
    SELECT 
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.PT) as patient_avg_pt,
        AVG(CASE WHEN l.ALP IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT != 0 THEN CAST(l.ALP AS REAL) / l.GPT ELSE NULL END) as patient_avg_ratio
    FROM Patient p
    INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL AND l.`U-PRO` != '-'
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
) patient_avgs
GROUP BY patient_avgs.SEX
